checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan migration of Coda into the AIKit projects folder

impact_assessment.why: The user directed that new software live under projects/ and be governed by AIKit; the existing copy sits outside the portfolio registry.
impact_assessment.benefits: One registered project with ledger, ADRs and gates; no duplicate source tree; deterministic output preserved.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: keep the 48 passing tests and byte-identical WAV output; dependency: Rust is installed but off PATH and needs the GNU toolchain; concurrency: the workspace has another agent's active cairn-arrays task that must not be touched; state: AIKit scaffold memory in .aikit must be preserved.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Copy source verbatim into the AIKit-created project, keep its .aikit memory, record ADRs via aikit adr, run cargo test and aikit check, never publish or push.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Migrated Coda source, examples, tests and verifier into projects/coda; recorded four ADRs and AIKit memory
[3/3] AIKit Phase 4 passed: 5/5 gates (hygiene, guidelines, secrets, compat, cargo test); 48 tests green; README and codebase map verified; local-only, no remote
